blurb: Core Dance creates and presents contemporary dance and movement-based art forms, supports artists through residencies and community programs, and offers studio rentals in downtown Decatur. Their 2026-27 season includes artist residencies, dance classes, film series, and public art installations. They provide space and resources for dance artists and culture bearers to develop innovative work.
extraNote: Refundable deposit required to book studio · Core Dance does not control parking lot or fee enforcement; parking is paid and public · Portion of parking fee donated to Core Dance · Back entrance accessible via North McDonough Street at the intersection of Trinity Avenue and Decatur Square, between Eddie's Attic and DeWoskin Law Firm.
